# Repository Skills

These skills help AI agents perform common repository tasks with consistent quality and validation.

- `contentpipeline-source-generator` — source generator feature/fix work
- `contentpipeline-test-triage` — build/test failure diagnosis and resolution
- `contentpipeline-docs-sync` — documentation updates coupled to behavior/API changes

Each skill is defined in a `SKILL.md` file under its folder.
